product_overview: The HRM system provides employee self-service and administrative workflows for authentication, profile access, employee management, leave approvals, and payroll processing. It uses JWT-secured APIs to support role-based access across employees, managers, HR, and administrators.
core_goals: Enable secure employee registration and login with JWT authentication
Allow employees to view their profile, leave requests, and payroll records
Provide HR and admin users with employee management capabilities
Support multi-tier leave approval workflows from manager to HR
Automate monthly payroll processing with leave deduction and payslip access

features.name: Auth Register
features.description: Public endpoint for creating a new employee account in the HRM system.
user_flows: POST /auth/register with valid first_name, last_name, email, password, and confirm_password -> Receive 201 with created employee data and omitted password
POST /auth/register with invalid email or mismatched confirm_password -> Receive 400 Bad Request with validation error details
POST /auth/register with an email that already exists -> Receive 409 Conflict indicating the account already exists

features.name: Auth Login
features.description: Public endpoint for authenticating users and issuing JWT access and refresh tokens.
user_flows: POST /auth/login with valid email and password -> Receive 201 with access_token and refresh_token
POST /auth/login with invalid credentials -> Receive 401 Unauthorized with authentication failure message
POST /auth/login for a terminated user account -> Receive 401 Unauthorized because the account is not allowed to authenticate

features.name: User Profile
features.description: Authenticated endpoint for retrieving the current user's profile, including department, job title, and manager relations.
user_flows: GET /profile with a valid Bearer token -> Receive 200 with the authenticated user's profile details
GET /profile without a Bearer token or with an invalid token -> Receive 401 Unauthorized

features.name: Employees Management
features.description: Role-protected CRUD management for employee records by HR_MANAGER and ADMIN users.
user_flows: POST /employees with a valid Bearer token and employee details -> Receive 201 with the created employee record and id
GET /employees?page=1&limit=10 with HR_MANAGER or ADMIN token -> Receive 200 with paginated employee results
GET /employees/:id with HR_MANAGER or ADMIN token -> Receive 200 with a single employee detail record
PATCH /employees/:id with HR_MANAGER or ADMIN token and updated fields -> Receive 200 with the updated employee record
DELETE /employees/:id with HR_MANAGER or ADMIN token -> Receive 200 and the employee status changes to TERMINATED
GET /employees without sufficient role permissions -> Receive 403 Forbidden
POST /employees with missing required fields or malformed data -> Receive 400 Bad Request with validation errors

features.name: Leave Requests Workflow
features.description: Employee leave request submission and multi-step approval flow through manager and HR.
user_flows: POST /leave-requests with a Bearer token and valid start_date, end_date, and leave type -> Receive 201 with a new leave request in PENDING status
GET /leave-requests/my-requests with a Bearer token -> Receive 200 with the authenticated user's leave request list
PATCH /leave-requests/:id/approve-manager with a MANAGER token -> Receive 200 and the request status changes to APPROVED_BY_MANAGER
PATCH /leave-requests/:id/approve-hr with an HR_MANAGER token after manager approval -> Receive 200 and the request status changes to APPROVED_BY_HR
PATCH /leave-requests/:id/reject with a MANAGER or HR_MANAGER token -> Receive 200 and the request status changes to REJECTED
PATCH /leave-requests/:id/approve-manager without MANAGER permission -> Receive 403 Forbidden
POST /leave-requests with invalid date range or missing required dates -> Receive 400 Bad Request with validation errors

features.name: Payrolls Processing
features.description: Payroll processing and retrieval of payroll records for employees and authorized roles.
user_flows: POST /payrolls/process with an HR_MANAGER token and a valid pay period -> Receive 201 with the list of created payrolls after leave deductions are applied
GET /payrolls/my-payrolls with a Bearer token -> Receive 200 with the authenticated user's payroll records and pagination metadata
GET /payrolls/:id with a Bearer token for the owning user -> Receive 200 with the payroll details
GET /payrolls with HR_MANAGER or ADMIN token -> Receive 200 with all payroll records and pagination metadata
POST /payrolls/process with a non-HR_MANAGER token -> Receive 403 Forbidden
POST /payrolls/process with missing pay_period_start or pay_period_end -> Receive 400 Bad Request with validation errors
